SELECT substr(id, 1, instr(id, '-', instr(id,'-')+1)) as prefix, COUNT(*) 
FROM modules GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN id LIKE '%-l1-%' THEN 'l1'
    WHEN id LIKE '%-l2-%' THEN 'l2'
    WHEN id LIKE '%-l3-%' THEN 'l3'
    WHEN id LIKE '%-l4-%' THEN 'l4'
    WHEN id LIKE '%-l5-%' THEN 'l5'
    ELSE 'other'
  END as layer, COUNT(*)
FROM modules GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH RECURSIVE dep(module_id) AS (
  SELECT subject_id FROM module_depends_on_package WHERE object_id = 'package:fx10-legacy'

  SELECT m.subject_id

  JOIN dep d ON m.object_id = d.module_id
)
SELECT module_id FROM dep ORDER BY module_id

WITH RECURSIVE legacy_modules(module_id) AS (

  UNION

)

FROM service_implements_module sim
JOIN legacy_modules lm ON lm.module_id = sim.object_id
ORDER BY 1

WITH task_ctx AS (
  SELECT 'task:fx10-cutover' AS task_id
),
retiring AS (
  SELECT trp.object_id AS package_id
  FROM task_retires_package trp
  JOIN task_ctx t ON trp.subject_id = t.task_id
),
legacy_modules AS (
  SELECT subject_id AS module_id FROM module_depends_on_package
  WHERE object_id = (SELECT package_id FROM retiring)
  UNION
  SELECT m.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module m
  JOIN legacy_modules lm ON m.object_id = lm.module_id
),
legacy_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN legacy_modules lm ON lm.module_id = sim.object_id
),
cleared_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT tvs.object_id AS service_id
  FROM test_verifies_service tvs
),
remaining_services AS (
  SELECT service_id
  FROM legacy_services
  WHERE service_id NOT IN (SELECT service_id FROM cleared_services)
),
prod_scope_services AS (
  -- production dependency scope: services deployed to task-target deployment
  SELECT DISTINCT sdd.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sdd
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id
  JOIN task_ctx t ON ttd.subject_id = t.task_id
  UNION
  -- fallback: if none, all services in view are production-relevant for cutover
  SELECT service_id FROM remaining_services
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM service_deployed_to_deployment sdd
    JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdd.object_id
    JOIN task_ctx t ON ttd.subject_id = t.task_id
  )
)
SELECT 'services' as kind, service_id as id FROM remaining_services
WHERE service_id IN (SELECT service_id FROM prod_scope_services)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'deployments', sdd.object_id
FROM remaining_services rs
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = rs.service_id
WHERE rs.service_id IN (SELECT service_id FROM prod_scope_services)
UNION
SELECT 'deployments', ttd.object_id
FROM task_targets_deployment ttd
JOIN task_ctx t ON ttd.subject_id = t.task_id
ORDER BY kind, id

WITH RECURSIVE legacy_modules(module_id) AS (
  SELECT mdp.subject_id
  FROM task_retires_package trp
  JOIN module_depends_on_package mdp ON mdp.object_id = trp.object_id
  WHERE trp.subject_id = 'task:fx10-cutover'
  UNION
  SELECT m.subject_id
  FROM module_depends_on_module m
  JOIN legacy_modules lm ON m.object_id = lm.module_id
),
legacy_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN legacy_modules lm ON lm.module_id = sim.object_id
),
cleared_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT object_id AS service_id
  FROM test_verifies_service
),
remaining_services AS (
  SELECT service_id
  FROM legacy_services
  WHERE service_id NOT IN (SELECT service_id FROM cleared_services)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT json_group_array(service_id) FROM (
      SELECT service_id FROM remaining_services ORDER BY service_id
  )) AS affected_services,
  (SELECT json_group_array(object_id) FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT sdd.object_id
      FROM remaining_services rs
      JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdd ON sdd.subject_id = rs.service_id
      ORDER BY object_id
  )) AS affected_deployments
